answer: Membership you cannot buy in a hurry. DAO membership tenure makes the token's age the credential: membership tokens held through three bear markets. The ledger is public, so the beacon of the whole design is the timestamp - a token bought last week was born last week, and anyone can check. A farm would need a thousand such tokens, and the canyon that makes it hurt is the waiting itself: three crashes survived, three recoveries held, no way to fast-forward. The raven that closes the check is the vote record - a token that never voted through a downturn has no history to show.
